variances.meaning_english: to strike/deal a blow to someone; metaphorically extended to 'striking off/journeying in the land' for trade or travel
variances.citation: قرآن: وإذا ضربتم في الأرض فليس عليكم جناح أن تقصروا من الصلاة

variances.meaning: يقولون: إن الإسراع إلى السَّير أيضًا ضَرْب
variances.meaning_english: hastening one's pace/travel is also called ضرب
variances.citation: شعر: فإنّ الذي كنتم تحذرون ... أتانا عيونٌ تَضْرِبُ به

variances.meaning_english: a bird circling in search of sustenance
a man given to striking hard/often

variances.meaning: الصِّيغة؛ يقال: هذا من ضَرْب فلان، أي صِيغته، لأنّه إذا صاغ شيئًا فقد ضربه
variances.meaning_english: type/mold; 'this is of so-and-so's ضرب' meaning his manner/mold, since shaping something is a kind of striking

variances.meaning: المِثْل، كأنّهما ضُرِبا بضَرْبٍ واحد وصِيغا صِياغة واحدة
variances.meaning_english: an equal/counterpart, as if the two were struck from a single mold and cast in a single casting

variances.meaning: الصَّقيع، كأنّ السماء ضربت به الأرض
variances.meaning_english: frost, as if the sky struck the earth with it
that which frost has struck/afflicted
variances.citation: شعر: ومَضروبٍ يَبِنّ بغَير ضَرْبٍ ... يُطاوِحه الطِّرافُ إلى الطِّراف

variances.meaning: ما خُلِط سُخْنه بحقينه، كأنّ أحدهما قد ضُرِب على الآخر
variances.meaning_english: milk of which the hot is mixed with the soured/curdled, as if one struck upon the other
honeycomb, as if the bees 'struck'/produced it

variances.meaning: كأنّ الإنسان قد ضُرِب عليها وصِيغ صِيغة
variances.meaning_english: one's natural disposition, as if a person were struck/molded upon it
the striking edge/part of a sword — the part by which one strikes

variances.meaning: ويقال للمُصَنَّف من الشَّيء: الضَّرْب، كأنّه ضُرِب على مِثال ما سواه من ذلك الشَّيء
variances.meaning_english: a 'type/category' of a thing, as if struck upon the mold of its like

variances.meaning_english: to desist/refrain from a matter, as if one intended to proceed but 'struck' oneself, restraining oneself from what one wanted

variances.meaning: أقام (فيما يُحكى عن أبي زيد عن العرب)، وقياسه قياس الكلمة التي قبلها
variances.meaning_english: he stayed/remained in his house — reported from Abu Zayd on the authority of the Arabs; analogous to the preceding word

variances.meaning: المَحَلّ الغَليظة (كذا)، كأنّها ضُرِبت ضربًا، كما يقال نَفَضْت الشَّيء نَفْضًا والمنفوض نَفَض
variances.meaning_english: unclear precise referent (a place/substance term, possibly relating to churned milk-fat); as if it were 'struck', analogous to نفض/منفوض

variances.meaning: سُمِّي ضريبًا لأنّه مع الذي يضربها، فسُمِّي ضريبًا كالقعيد والجليس
variances.meaning_english: the one in charge of the divining-arrows, called ضريب because he accompanies the one who casts them — like قعيد (companion) and جليس (sitting-companion)

variances.meaning: استعارة: شُبِّه في خفَّته بالضَّريبة التي يضربها الإنسان
variances.meaning_english: metaphor: a slender/light-bodied man, likened in his lightness to the target/mark struck by a person
variances.citation: شعر: أنا الرَّجل الضَّرْب الذي تعرفونه ... خشاشٌ كرأس الحيَّة المُتوقِّد

variances.meaning: المتنحِّي في الوادي، كأنّه نَهْجٌ يَضْرِب في الوادي ضربًا
variances.meaning_english: one who veers off into the valley, as if a path 'strikes off' into the valley

intense/vigorous running
stained/split open with blood

variances.meaning_english: the lion — a blend of the two words ḍaghm (biting) and ḍaram (blazing), as if it blazes until it bites

entries.core_meaning_english: the strong one; the nūn is augmented, from ḍabaṭa (to grip firmly)
